conf.comment: NetBackup anomaly-detection REST feed, direct route. The work order itself flags this dataset as a 'thin starter... documented by column rather than by wire field name' -- Job ID/Client name/Score/Anomaly summary/etc are the NetBackup UI's report column labels, not confirmed JSON keys. Per the brief's no-guessing rule this pipeline does NOT rename any of the 11 fields; it only extracts JSON and tags event.dataset. Field-by-field mapping (including the Feature details "N (Usual low, high)" split, for which the work order gives a concrete example) is deferred until a live sample confirms the real wire keys. See README gaps.
